§ 01 · The Program

Real ventures,
real decisions.

From validating an idea and raising a seed round, to building a founding team, finding product-market fit, and scaling into new markets, every scenario drops you into a genuine startup situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Forty-four foundations-focused scenarios and fifty-six growth-and-scale-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real founder judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation an entrepreneur or startup professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across ideation, fundraising, product, growth, team-building, and scaling.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound founder judgment under real startup pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Startup Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping founders and startup professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency for entrepreneurs isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, startups and entrepreneurial ventures in English — Mr. Gad Entrepreneurship & Startups is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the founder moments you'll actually face.
